subject: find original working directory from within runApp()?

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: find original working directory from within runApp()?
parts: I'm using a function wrapped around `runApp()` to call a shiny application.  `runApp()` changes the user's working directory for the duration of the run.  If I want to be able to get the value of the original working directory for use within `server.R`, is there some obvious/preferred/best way to do this?  (The use case is that I want users to be able to save the plot, and I want it to go into their original working directory by default  ...)
